description:
As a customer, I want to search so I can find a tool quickly.

* A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
* A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
* Search is case-insensitive.
* Clearing the search restores the full product list.

Search matches product names (partial, case-insensitive)

criteria.text: A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
Clearing the search restores the full product list.

cases.title: Search term matching existing products lists only matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <at least one product whose name contains a chosen search term> and <at least one product whose name does not contain that term>.
steps: Note which products are shown before searching.
Enter <a search term contained in the name of at least one product> in the search field.
cases.expected: Only the products whose names contain the search term are listed; products that do not match are not shown.

cases.title: Search term with no matches shows empty state message and no error
cases.preconditions: The product list contains products, and <a search term that matches no product name> is known.
steps: Enter <a search term that matches no product name> in the search field.
cases.expected: No products are listed and an empty state message is shown (exact wording not specified in the story). No error is shown.

cases.title: Search is case-insensitive
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name contains a term with mixed upper and lower case letters>.
steps: Enter the term in all lower case in the search field and run the search.
Clear the search field, enter the same term in all upper case and run the search.
Compare the results with the previous ones.
cases.expected: Both searches list the same matching product(s); the result does not depend on the case used in the search term.

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <several products, at least one of which does not match the search term used>.
steps: Open the product list page and note the full list of products shown.
Enter <a search term contained in the name of at least one product> and run the search.
cases.expected: The full product list is shown again, matching the list noted in step 1.

cases.title: Partial product name matches
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name is longer than the fragment used for searching>.
steps: Enter only a fragment of that product's name (not the complete name) in the search field.
cases.expected: The product whose name contains the fragment is listed.

cases.title: Partial match from the middle of a product name in different case
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name contains a fragment that is not at the start of the name>.
steps: Enter that mid-name fragment with its letter case changed (e.g. opposite case) in the search field.
cases.expected: The product whose name contains the fragment is listed, since matching on product names is partial and case-insensitive.
